div.div: 5 تريّغت اللُّقْمَةُ بِالسَّمْنِ (assumed tropical:) The morsel, or mouthful, was [smeared, seasoned,] imbued, or soaked, (تَرَوَّت,) with clarified butter. (En-Nadr, TA.) [In the CK, and in some MS. copies of the K, this verb is mentioned as quasi-pass. of 2.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
